fusions.name: Shoal of Needles
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 venomed needles in a spread out to 6 tiles, each of which deals 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ripple Along the Line
fusions.desc: Snaps a wet line at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Air Film
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a film of air that absorbs the next 16 damage and holds for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Surface Skater

riders.text: you skate it faster than you cross ground
and every ripple on it reaches you
and nothing that has to wade can reach you

fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. From bronze rank you move 12% faster over it, from silver your mana recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 10%.
